win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 26. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

multipliers.name: Cursed Chests
multipliers.behavior:
Landed Cursed Chests open up to create a Cursed Area from their position to the top of the reel, if the Cursed Area would include at least one winning combination.

 Opened Cursed Chests reveal a Cursed Multiplier that is applied to the Cursed Area on that reel. All winning paylines that include a symbol in the Cursed Area are multiplied by the multiplier for that Cursed Area. If a winning payline is affected by more than one multiplier, the multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Cursed Chest multipliers can have one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x

modes.name: Sunken Treasure bonus game
modes.trigger: Land 3 Lantern scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus feature that starts with 10 free spins.
modes.effects:
Land 3 Lantern scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus feature that starts with 10 free spins.

 In this bonus feature, Cursed Chests that land always open and create a Cursed Area that persists until the end of the feature. The Cursed Area on a reel grows if a new Cursed Chest lands below it.

 All Cursed Multipliers from opened Cursed Chests are added to a Total Multiplier above the reels, which affects all Cursed Areas. All winning paylines that pass through any Cursed Areas are multiplied by the Total Multiplier.

 Landing additional Lantern symbols at the same time during the feature awards extra free spins:

 2 Lantern symbols awards 2 additional spins.
3 Lantern symbols awards 4 additional spins.
4 Lantern symbols awards 6 additional spins.

modes.name: Dead Men Tell No Tales bonus game
modes.trigger: Land 4 Lantern scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus feature in which you get 3 refilling lives.
modes.effects:
Land 4 Lantern scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus feature in which you get 3 refilling lives. Each life equals one free spin.

 This feature contains only non-winning symbols and special Skull and Kraken symbols.

 Above each reel is a multiplier value that starts at 1x and can be progressively increased throughout the feature.

 The Cursed Skull symbol reveals a multiplier value that is added to the total multiplier above the reel where it landed and creates a Cursed Area from its position to the top of the reel. The Cursed Area on a reel grows if a new Cursed Skull lands below it.

 Cursed Skull multipliers can have one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 150x, 200x, 250x, 500x

 The Tormented Skull symbol reveals a multiplier value that multiplies the total multiplier above the reel where it landed.

 Tormented Skull multipliers can have one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20, x25

 The Kraken symbol reveals a multiplier value that is added to the total multiplier above all reels.

 Kraken multipliers can have one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 150x, 200x, 250x, 500x

 Whenever at least one of the special Skull or Kraken symbols land on a spin, all 3 lives refill. The feature ends after three spins in a row without any of the special symbols landing.

 At the end of the feature, the multiplier value above each reel will be added to all Cursed Area positions on the respective reels.
The sum of all multipliers in Cursed Areas will then be multiplied by the bet to determine the awarded win.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable.

 The Cursed Chest symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable.
